## Reviewer questions (answer before requesting review)

- **Delegated:** the task + its acceptance criteria.
- **Constrained:** the specs/patterns/guardrails this worked within.
- **Evidence:** the tests/lint/CI that prove it, and the intent the tests encode.
- **Human review:** what a person must look at closely here.
- **Accountable:** who owns this decision.

## Definition of Done checklist

- [ ] Linked to a Jira issue (SCRUM-xx)
- [ ] All acceptance criteria for the issue are met
- [ ] Tests written and passing (unit and/or E2E); no existing test weakened to go green
- [ ] No regressions introduced in existing functionality
- [ ] RBAC, input validation, and error handling considered; no secrets committed
- [ ] If this is an architectural/safety-critical/schema/auth decision or an accepted trade-off, an entry was added to `docs/DECISION_LOG.md`
- [ ] Documentation updated where relevant (README, comments, Confluence)
- [ ] A human reviewer understood the code, including any AI-generated parts
